coverage.scope: Synthetic demonstration: two fictional works; related activity window 2025–2026. No real scholarly evidence.
coverage.limitation: All people, publications, institutions and passages are invented. No claim of completeness.

evidence.note: The 2021 book is separate; the catalogue explicitly links the 2024 manuscript and 2025 article as versions of one work.
Ivo Morn proposes that a shared record allows actors to negotiate responsibility; a record does not mechanically determine decisions.
The article explicitly cites Morn’s fictional 2021 book.
Rook proposes a contested-entry mechanism: recording an exception makes responsibility negotiable. The author limits this to two observed settings.
Tavi Reed is a researcher at the fictional Northlake Centre.

evidence.locator: Fictional official profile, dated project entry
evidence.note: The fictional profile announces Reed’s 2026-03-12 project studying maintenance records.

works.title: Contested entries in local maintenance (fictional)
works.identity_note: The fictional catalogue explicitly identifies the manuscript and article as versions of the same work.

proposition.zh: 记录可以使责任成为协商对象。

mechanism.en: A shared entry gives participants a common object for contesting a decision.
mechanism.zh: 共享条目为参与者提供质疑决定的共同对象。

misreading.en: A record does not automatically coordinate everyone.
misreading.zh: 记录不会自动使所有人协调一致。

proposition.en: Recording an exception can reopen responsibility negotiations.
proposition.zh: 记下例外可能重新开启责任协商。

mechanism.en: An exception becomes visible, participants contest it, and roles may be renegotiated.
mechanism.zh: 例外可见后，参与者提出异议，责任分工可能被重新协商。

misreading.en: The mechanism is proposed for two sites, not universal.
misreading.zh: 该机制针对两个场所提出，不能直接推广为普遍规律。

definition.en: A durable entry accessible to multiple participants and used in joint decisions.
definition.zh: 多名参与者能访问并用于共同决策的持久条目。

example.en: Illustration: a repair log lets two teams discuss who should respond.
example.zh: 示例：维修日志让两个团队讨论由谁处理。

definition.en: An entry whose classification or assigned responsibility is challenged.
definition.zh: 其分类或责任归属受到质疑的记录条目。

example.en: Illustration: a team challenges the owner assigned to an unusual repair.
example.zh: 示例：团队质疑一项特殊维修的责任归属。

label.en: Proposed and examined in this article
Interpretive comparison: from a shared object to a contested entry
label.zh: 解读性比较：从共同对象到争议条目

claim.en: The author proposes contested entry as a bounded mechanism; wider novelty is not assessed.
claim.zh: 作者提出有适用边界的争议条目机制；此处未评定其在整个领域的原创性。

relation.en: Analyst comparison: a shared research question about maintenance records, not documented collaboration.
relation.zh: 导览者比较：共同关注维修记录问题，未声称已经合作。

label.en: Proposal: test whether a repair-log review helps teams negotiate exceptions.
label.zh: 建议：测试维修日志复核能否帮助团队协商例外情况。

impact_claims.next_step: Identify willing participants and agree a study protocol; no collaboration or outcome is documented.
